info.title: JomCall local core
info.description: Phase 1. Runtime mode is server-controlled. Provider actions are unavailable. Request schemas are generated from the named command registry; response envelope is machine-readable, detailed response types live in packages/contracts/src/core.ts. No cloud deployment implied.
